visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Extract isPrime and Stop Early
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The loop tests every divisor below n and keeps going after one has been found. Write an isPrime method that returns as soon as a divisor is found and only checks up to the square root. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Returning at the first divisor and stopping at the square root cuts the work from n steps to about the square root of n. Comparing a boolean with == true is unnecessary; the boolean can be used directly.

tests.pattern:
(?<![\s\S])\s*17 is prime[ 	]*?
18 is not prime[ 	]*?
19 is prime[ 	]*?
20 is not prime[ 	]*?
21 is not prime\s*(?![\s\S])
